labels.name: bug
labels.rationale: Reports unexpected deadlock behaviour, but no runnable reproduction was given.

labels.name: more information needed
labels.rationale: Needs a minimal runnable example; stack dumps and lock analysis are not a reproduction.

items.body:
The lock analysis is useful, but this report does not include a runnable reproduction, so a maintainer cannot yet confirm the deadlock. Please add a minimal, self-contained script that uses `Live` with `redirect_stdout=True`, `redirect_stderr=True` and `auto_refresh=True`, and a worker thread or task that prints or logs while the display refreshes. A script that deadlocks reliably within a few seconds is the most helpful form. Please also include the output of `python -m rich.diagnose`.

Related earlier reports: #927 (deadlock when exiting a `Status` context, which also involves the refresh thread and lock) and #3125 (redirected output with `Live`).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
